about: The sky's tuning figures (Weather/SkyModel.h, skies plan). The game reads this at start (ATorqueSky): change a figure, restart, no recompile. A figure left out keeps its default. Curves are [x, y] points, straight between. sky_test checks the presets still give the light they always had.

light._shade: The light in a hill's shadow by day: sky_fill is the sky light times the level's by the sun's height (degrees), less as the sky dulls; under a bright sky only, the camera may open exposure_shade_open stops below the level's lowest, and more as the sun is lower than exposure_built_deg (times exposure_follow_sun, at most exposure_follow_most); local_* are the engine's local exposure. ALL OFF (147's light) since build 148 looked washed out with them (1.9x sky light, up to 4 stops more exposure, local shadows 0.6): beenster's dark shade in 147 was at Medium quality, where Lumen is off. Raise gently only if a shade at Epic is still too dark.

kinds._: Each kind's look: shape 0 heaped .. 1 flat; lumps 0 big .. 1 small; ragged edges; density; base_dark; depth_m (+ cape_depth x the CAPE heap); sheet (high cloud: 0 wisps .. 1 veil).

cloud._scatter: How the cloud scatters the sun (build 147: grey, blotchy cumulus). cloud_phase_g the forward lobe (silver linings towards the sun), cloud_phase_g2 the back lobe, cloud_phase_blend between them; cloud_ms_* the light bounced about inside the cloud: its share, how much the cloud shades it, how forward it goes. cloud_ms_octaves (0..2) is built into the material: change it and rebuild the level. cloud_ms_dull: the share of the bounced light left under a dull sky (a deck's base stays grey).
cloud._marching: The cloud's ray marching (build 148: the grey drizzle sky sparkled and flickered): cloud_view_samples and cloud_shadow_samples are times the engine's samples (more is smoother, costs GPU; restart only); density_most caps the material's density (x 0.1 per metre); cloud_ground_light 0/1 lights the base from the ground (built into the material: rebuild the level).

kinds_rules._: Stage 3: which kind of cloud each layer shows. Every rule is a band blended across, never a switch.

seen_coming._: Stage 4: fog with a top, valley mist (Local Fog Volumes in the hollows), rainbow rule; the air thickening under a low base; the weather map drawn into the clouds; rain shafts under far showers; the rainbow drawn.

night._: Stage 5: the moon's light once the sun's is gone (boosted: the real 0.25 lux would be black), the moon's disc, the stars (Data/Sky/stars.png, the Yale Bright Star Catalogue), the Milky Way, the towns' glow.

storms._: Stage 7: thunderstorms (towering to thunder_top_m with an anvil), lightning (each storm cell of a lattice storm_spacing_m apart flashes flashes_per_min a minute at full strength; ground_share fork to the ground), the flash's glow in the cloud and its light on the land, thunder at sound_mps (made in code, no recordings), hail and snow curtains, and the flat bright light under snow cloud.

rare._: Stage 7: rare skies. Sun dogs in thin ice cloud by a low sun; contrails that linger in cold damp air 9 km up; a fogbow in thin fog and a glory seen from above it; the aurora from NOAA's Kp index (the oval's edge at aurora_oval_deg - aurora_kp_step x Kp geomagnetic latitude, seen aurora_seen_beyond degrees further south); noctilucent cloud on summer nights; meteors (the sporadic ones and the year's showers); Saharan dust from Open-Meteo's air quality feed.

clouds_v2._about: The clouds (M_RideCloudV2, rebuilt Nov 16; the old ones removed Nov 17). v2_shape_m: the low layer's form size in metres (times 1.3 .. 0.7 by its kind's lumps); v2_detail_m its edge detail; v2_mid_* the middle layer's; v2_broad_m and v2_patchy the weather's own patches; v2_erode (+ v2_erode_ragged x the kind's raggedness) how much the detail eats the edges; v2_edge_sharp how crisp the skins; v2_billow how much of the forms a third the size; v2_extinction per metre at a kind's density 1 (real cumulus 0.05 .. 0.1); v2_deck_thin times that for a flat deck (lighter undersides, stratocumulus is thinner stuff); v2_detail_deep_m: a layer deeper than this gets coarser edge detail, by sqrt(depth / it), so tall shower clouds marched in long steps don't shimmer; cover from v2_closed_from to v2_closed_full closes the sky into one lumpy sheet (below it, gaps, as 7/8 stratocumulus); v2_detail_fade_km: the edge detail (to half) and crisp skins fade out over this distance (far off they only sparkle: build 155 shimmer). Preview without the game: python Tools/cloud_preview.py.
